text:
Sam (AE): Quick heads-up — prospect (regional bank) requests: ISO 27001 scope excerpt, SOC2 control mapping for data handling (storage+ingress), a signed pen-test attestation, and an upload channel for logs/configs. They asked explicitly for SFTP or a mounted SMB share. Need feasibility + rough cost.

Dev (Solutions): SMB mount is a no-go for us. We can offer: A) presigned S3 with IP restrictions + bucket scoped to the customer, B) ephemeral SFTP gateway that writes to that bucket. Both support lifecycle delete after 7d. Which does legal prefer?

Ivy (Security): From security: we require a redaction attestation from them (they claim they'll redact), SHA256 manifest, and allowed file list. We also insist on AV scanning on our side and upload quarantine until scan passes. Pen-test attestation must be a signed letter from their vendor with date and scope; we will provide our own one-paragraph attestation confirming we run vendor pentests twice yearly.

Sam (AE): Customer insists on SFTP citing corporate policy. If we provide an SFTP gateway we should confirm rotation policy and session logging.

Dev (Solutions): Ops note: we can spin up a per-tenant SFTP->S3 gateway (short-lived host) with key pairs rotated after upload and syslog forwarded to our SIEM. We will require a single static source IP from the customer for allowlist.

Marco (RevOps): Pricing: short POC (5 days) with reserved nodes + secure ingestion = +$4,000. Adding a managed SFTP gateway + monitoring = +$600. If they accept presigned links instead, discount of $400. I'll draft a POQ and post link.

Claire (Legal): We'll need to see the customer's legal basis for requesting raw logs. If they want ISO excerpts or SOC2 artifact we require an NDA. We can send a redacted SOC2 control mapping PDF under NDA; full SOC2 report not shared. I can pre-author the one-paragraph pen-test attestation for our signature.

Sam (AE): Timeline: customer wants evidence drop by Thu. I'll ask for their CIDR and whether they can accept presigned PUTs.

Dev (Solutions): Sample presign flow if they go that route:

```
# get presign
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api/presign -d '{"name":"access.log"}' | jq -r .url
# upload
curl -X PUT "<url>" -T access.log -H "Content-Type: text/plain"
```

Dev (Solutions): Also posting a short checklist for uploads: allowed: .log .txt .zip .json .pdf; max per file 2GB; manifest.csv with filename, sha256; do not include secrets or unredacted PII.

Ivy (Security): Redaction specifics: mask full IPs (x.x.x.x), remove headers containing auth tokens, remove usernames/emails unless minimalized, strip PDF metadata. We'll accept an attestation CSV stating which fields were redacted.

evidence-bot: Automated note — bucket poc-2950001111 created; lifecycle rule = 7d auto-delete; quarantine prefix = /incoming/quarantine/.

Marco (RevOps): POQ draft: https://redwood-internal/quotes/2950001111-poc-evidence (internal). Pricing includes short reserved capacity, storage, gateway, monitoring.

Claire (Legal): Upload NDA template for SOC2/ISO artifacts posted: https://drive.internal/nda/soc2-short-poc. If they refuse NDA we can still provide the one-paragraph pen-test attestation and high-level SOC2 scoping statement (no control evidence).

Sam (AE): Action list: Dev to confirm SFTP gateway ETA (target: tomorrow morning), Marco to send quote to prospect, Ivy to attach redaction checklist and sample manifest, Claire to prep NDA+pen-test attestation. I'll coordinate CIDRs and send them the upload window.

Dev (Solutions): Ops confirmed gateway available but preference for presigned links. If customer insists on SFTP, we'll provide host+key by tomorrow and enable syslog.

Sam (AE): Thanks team 60a will update customer after Marco/Dev/Ivy/Claire post.

Ivy (Security): Redaction checklist posted to thread and uploaded to drive: https://drive.internal/redaction/checklist-poc-2950001111
